newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity mgr Ellison to join Friedman, Billings.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity mgr Ellison to join Friedman, Billings.

text.p: Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc said David Ellison, portfolio manager of the Fidelity Select Home Finance Fund, will join the firm as managing director and partner, effective Oct 2.
Ellison, whose $759 million fund has a five-star rating from Morningstar Inc, will run a mutual fund operation that Friedman, Billing is setting up.
Eric Billings, the firm's vice chairman and chief operating officer, said four mutual funds are currently under registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Billings said he expects the funds, intended both for retail and instituitional clients, to reach the market in November.
Billings said that Ellison was recruited because of his "peerless" record, and added that he placed Ellison among the top-10 portfolio managers in the United States.
Ellison has managed the fund since Dec, 1985.
The fund has returned 18.74 percent year to date versus 13.25 percent for the average specialty finance, and 53.49 percent for 1995 versus 41.13 for the average fund, according to Morningstar.
For the five year period, the fund returned 32.39 percent versus 22.64 for the average fund.
Friedman, Billings, currently manages assets of about $300 million in hedge funds.
-- Jeff Benkoe, Wall Street Desk, 212-859-1735/E-mail: jeff.benkoe@reuters.com
